landing.mtdA1Body: Sole traders and landlords keep digital records and send HMRC an update every quarter, plus a final declaration after the year ends.
landing.mtdA2Body: Since April 2026 for qualifying income over £50,000. Over £30,000 from April 2027 and over £20,000 from April 2028.
landing.mtdA3Body: Each client now owes you records four times a year. PracticeNudge asks for them and sends the reminders for you.
landing.mtdA4Body: Import clients from a CSV, pick a ready-made UK template and send. Clients upload from a link, with no account or app.
landing.mtdA5Title: Every client's status in one view
landing.mtdA5Body: See who has sent what, what is missing and who is late, with reminders before each deadline and after it.
landing.problemTitle: MTD is coming. Your client list is still living in a spreadsheet.
landing.problemText1: Most small practices don't have a single answer to "who's ready, who isn't, who needs chasing this week." That information is scattered across emails, sticky notes, and a tab in someone's Excel file.
landing.problemText2: Meanwhile, HMRC deadlines keep moving closer.
landing.problemText3: For small practices without a dedicated ops team, keeping track of 50–200 clients' MTD readiness is a manual, repetitive headache.
landing.problemCard1Body: By the time you've updated one column, another is wrong.
landing.problemCard2Body: You re-type the same email 30 times, then forget who replied.
landing.problemCard3Body: You discover the gaps on the deadline, not in advance.
landing.problemCard4Body: 'Probably ready' is not an answer your clients will accept.
landing.fiveEyebrow: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax
landing.fiveB1: Records kept in software, sent to HMRC every three months, plus a final declaration after the year ends.
landing.fiveB3: Client numbers arrive all year, so gaps show up months earlier.
landing.fiveB4: That's what PracticeNudge does. Import a CSV, send requests and set up in an afternoon.
landing.fiveB5: 4 quarterly deadlines tracked for every client: what's in, what's missing and who to nudge next.
landing.solutionTitle: One dashboard. One question. Who needs chasing next?
landing.solutionSubtitle: Tag readiness, fill the gaps, send the reminder. PracticeNudge keeps your MTD client list calm, current, and chasable.
landing.solutionFeature1: See who's ready, who's at risk, and who needs chasing
landing.solutionFeature2: Track missing documents and information per client
landing.solutionFeature3: Set follow-up reminders so nothing slips through
landing.solutionFeature4: Built specifically for small UK accountants and bookkeepers using Xero, QuickBooks, or FreeAgent
landing.feature1Body: Seven plain-English statuses, from Not assessed to MTD ready, so progress is visible at a glance.
landing.feature2Body: Each client has a checklist. Missing income band, software, records... all flagged in one place.
landing.feature3Body: Reusable templates with your branding. Send, track replies, mark resolved.
landing.feature4Body: Subtle colour-coded risk levels show which clients are about to slip, before they do.
landing.feature5Title: Plan the week with one view
landing.feature5Body: Upcoming follow-ups, by date, by client, by status. No more rebuilt task lists every Monday.
landing.feature6Body: Automatic per-channel consent collection. Clients choose email, SMS, or both. You see who's approved what, in real time.
landing.howItWorksTitle: Set up in an afternoon. Use it the same week.
landing.step1Text: CSV from Xero, QuickBooks or your own spreadsheet. Or add them one by one.
landing.step2Text: Walk down the list, assign a status and risk level. Plain English, no jargon.
landing.step3Text: Send a templated reminder; tick records as they come in.
landing.step4Text: Every client moves toward MTD ready. You always know what's next.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Per practice, not per client. Cancel any time.
landing.planFirmDesc: For small firms with multiple staff.
landing.faq1a: No. PracticeNudge does not file taxes or submit anything to HMRC. It's a tracking and chasing tool that sits alongside your existing software.
landing.faq2q: Does it replace Xero / QuickBooks / FreeAgent?
landing.faq2a: No. PracticeNudge works with your existing accounting software. It tracks client readiness and follow-ups; your accounting software handles the numbers.
landing.faq3q: How is this different from a spreadsheet?
landing.faq3a: Spreadsheets go stale. PracticeNudge gives you live status tracking, automated reminders, and a clear view without manual updates.
landing.faq4a: Yes. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We follow UK data protection standards and never share your client information.
landing.faq5q: What size practice is this for?
landing.faq5a: PracticeNudge is built for sole practitioners and small practices with 20–200 clients. If you're too small for enterprise tools but too busy for spreadsheets, this is for you.
landing.finalCtaTitle: Walk into MTD with a calm client list.
landing.finalCtaText: Pilot pricing is open for the first 50 small UK practices. 15-minute demo, no slide decks.
landing.footerDisclaimer: PracticeNudge is a client readiness tracking and follow-up tool. It is not tax filing software, does not submit data to HMRC, and does not provide tax, legal, or financial advice. Always consult a qualified professional for tax matters.
